summary: Authority and activation closure: MeasuredSnapshot/AdmissionGrant/ActiveRuntime separation, transactional activation with durable journal and rollback, explicit backend coverage, signed monotonic revocation snapshots, supervised AF_UNIX launch service with peer-credential authentication.

repairs.title: Transactional activation: durable intent before routing, atomic pointer, signed completion, rollback
repairs.behavior: The supervisor journals every transition before it takes effect; the active-version pointer is atomically swapped; the signed completion lands after; any failure aborts and unloads the candidate; recovery reconciles journal against pointer deterministically; rollback restores only a live handle.

repairs.title: Explicit backend coverage: a qualification that omits runtime_backends covers nothing
repairs.behavior: The QUALIFIED_BACKENDS default is removed; a signed qualification must declare a nonempty runtime_backends list; hf-peft coverage never transitively qualifies native backends.

repairs.title: Measurement != authorization: MeasuredSnapshot + AdmissionGrantV1 + supervised service
repairs.behavior: A staged artifact carries no deployment authority; the `admission` role issues short-lived single-use grants binding decision/qualification/manifest/artifact-root/backend/epochs/audience; the service process owns signing keys behind an authenticated Unix socket.

repairs.title: Authenticated monotonic revocation snapshots
repairs.behavior: RevocationSnapshotV2 is signed by the dedicated `revocation` role, epoch-monotonic, freshness-and-future bounded; the durable store publishes atomically and refuses epoch regression/replay; missing evidence fails closed.

features.title: v2 runtime manifest with explicit authorized file listing
features.note: mini-agi-v16.5-peft-runtime-manifest-v2 binds adapter_files; serving requires v2 (the launcher refuses aggregate-digest-only manifests).

features.title: RevocationList with generation time and freshness enforcement
features.note: The launcher requires a revocation list (default max age 7 days); a stale list refuses instead of being treated as empty.

features.title: Replay nonces recorded in an append-only journal
features.note: Each production receipt carries a fresh 128-bit nonce; the journal makes reuse detectable.

features.title: Trusted launch CLI and launcher rollback lineage
features.note: scripts/trusted_launch.py --backend-factory module:callable; rollback re-admits a previously receipted release and records rollback_of in the receipt.

adversarial_acceptance: a forged or caller-constructed snapshot is refused at supervisor stage()
an object with a path() method is refused
a qualification omitting runtime_backends is refused; hf-peft does not qualify qwen-native-cuda
one substituted adapter byte or an added symlink prevents activation
unsigned, forged, future-dated, stale, or epoch-regressing revocation evidence is refused
unsigned, wrong-role, wrong-audience, wrong-backend, digest-mismatched, expired, or stale-epoch grants are refused
receipt persistence failure after commit leaves no externally active candidate
a crash between commit and traffic switch is reconciled deterministically from the journal
revoking the active version quarantines it and restores the previous live runtime
a failed health probe leaves the previous healthy version serving

review_repairs.title: Tokenizer identity uses one shared plan convention
review_repairs.note: artifact_closure.tokenizer_artifact_digest is the single implementation of the plan's convention (tokenizer-named files inside the model snapshot); the runner delegates (plan digests unchanged, Campaign 3A resume preserved), the launcher re-measures it from the staged model, the backend serves the tokenizer from the verified model artifact, and an explicit tokenizer root is an optional cross-check.

review_repairs.title: Serving loads require an ApprovedSnapshot
review_repairs.note: load_causal_lm() with the default purpose='serving' previously fell through to a bare from_pretrained(spec.model_id) when no snapshot was passed; it now refuses, and the research-plane base-model call sites pass purpose='research'.

review_repairs.title: Release verifier refuses symlinks
review_repairs.note: An added symlink previously passed verification silently; links are now refused (symlinks_in_tree, exit 2), consistent with the artifact-closure policy and build_zip.py.

review_repairs.title: Snapshot staging validates names and always cleans up
review_repairs.note: An unauthorized artifact name raised a raw KeyError and left a partially staged, unfrozen tree behind; names are validated up front (SnapshotError, nothing staged) and any staging failure discards the destination.
